verdict.rationale: Multi-GPU distribution is a fair question for a local LLM inference runtime like llamafile, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents single-backend GPU acceleration (Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, Vulkan). Nothing in the pack mentions splitting inference across multiple GPUs via tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism, and general GPU support is an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism
